title: common/libimage/manifests: use our own pause image copy
body:
Somehow on registry.k8s.io blob
sha256:597c4e8bfd5eb55ef7a8c6dcbfbad9ee6ac9392c2f983c2b5498384ee2a7b16a returns http status 400 all of the sudden.

In general we should not rely on images not under our control as they can break at any time. So switch to using our own
quay.io/libpod/k8s-pause copy.

<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->

comments.body:
> (The urgency _seems_ to have passed, I can now copy all of the `registry.k8s.io` image.)

No, it’s broken again… feel free to merge with this image.
… just file an upstream issue for using a smaller one, please.

> Can we copy that small image to quay.io? Alternatively, docker://quay.io/libpod/alpine:3.10.2 is 7 platforms and 18 MB total (and I didn’t check other images, there might be smaller ones).

yes I agree, I was not aware the windows platforms are so large somehow...
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1117 to speed up the test/pulls by skipping windows
